notes: 15.59s  rushed sentence (392 wpm): But the strangest part is who LeBron played with back then.
heard: LeBron played in the finals before this rookie was born. Cameron Boozer, the Grizzlies number three pick out of Duke, was born July 18th, 2007. LeBron's finals ended June 14th, 34 days earlier. He had debuted in 2003, three years and eight months before Cameron arrived. Now Cameron is the league's youngest player. One of only 10 born in 2007, and LeBron in year 24 is the oldest. But the strangest part is who LeBron played with back then. Carlos Boozer, Cameron's father, started 75 games beside rookie LeBron in Cleveland. Now that teammate's son is the rookie.
